future_beacon.verification_boundary: P1 must cross-check exact response fields across at least three relays and verify randomness equals SHA-256(signature). Full BLS signature verification is not claimed by the standard-library verifier.

selection.algorithm: For each candidate id compute SHA256(randomness_bytes || UTF8('\0') || UTF8(candidate_id)); sort ascending by digest then id; take the first count.

audit_execution.executor_declaration_expected: a fresh isolated Codex sub-agent with no inherited conversation turns

allows: publish this successor protocol and its public audit receipts
publish the participant registry receipt supplied for this demonstration
run and publish selected non-destructive adversarial cases
excludes: private corpus content or private transcripts
wallet, settlement, trading or financial actions
changes to the frozen main branch or submitted PDF

claim_boundary.observed: Bytes, hashes, Git ancestry, public platform receipts, tool-dispatched actions, test outputs and explicitly scoped participant declarations.
claim_boundary.inferred: A later revision is consistent with and declares that it was informed by an earlier observation.
claim_boundary.externally_unverified: Internal causal experience, exclusive authorship, absence of every unobserved intervention, identity continuity, consent beyond the recorded scope, mind, consciousness or interiority.
